review.scientific: Internal pass: examined official syllabus and indexed authoritative NCBI/OpenStax/Canadian Blood Services sources and historical records. Checked membrane glycans, H dependence, codominance, IgM/IgG, complement, forward/reverse grouping, DAT/IAT, compatibility direction, RhD sensitisation and fetal disease. Verified all 55 correct option mappings; recomputed 27/64, 0.4138, 3/16, 7/16 and 4/7, 175 expected A or AB, 1/2 Rh discordant pair, 88 fetal cell units, fourfold titre, and 25 units after two half-lives. Hypothetical data distinguished from findings.
review.editorial: Distinct pass: 13 progressively sequenced sections, 151 unique prose paragraphs, corrected overlapping graphics and compatibility label, improved 21 analytical questions, balanced key positions within levels, added rapid revision comparison and diagram zoom controls. Checked all IDs, anchors, ARIA, tag nesting and JavaScript syntax.

score_basis: Internal assessment, not external certification. Deductions for incomplete full-text source review, unrendered illustrations, some elementary distractors, untested reader runtime and prepublication live verification. Coverage, depth, pedagogy, reasoning and revision supported by inspected chapter.
